# Known limitations and explicit assumptions

- Version 1 accepts CSV, XLSX and read-only XLSM. Legacy XLS, encrypted workbooks, UTF-16 CSV, chart-only workbooks and non-tabular record inputs are unsupported. CSV must have consistent field counts; choose a delimiter override when detection is uncertain.
- A complete workbook snapshot is held in RAM, including supported styles. Large workbooks can use much more RAM than their compressed file size. Excel's internal sparse-cell store is used to avoid walking its entire theoretical grid; this relies on the tested openpyxl version. Broadly formatted full-sheet workbooks can still be very large.
- Cancellation is cooperative. Python byte decoding, openpyxl's initial workbook load, and final workbook save cannot be interrupted internally; cancellation is checked before/after these stages and between processing units. The GUI remains responsive. Closing during an operation requests cancellation; close again after the operation stops.
- Stored formula expressions are compared; formulas are never calculated. A cached-values view is not implemented. If formula comparison is disabled in cell mode, value comparison for a cell containing a formula on either side is excluded, with a report notice. Record modes compare raw stored expressions as field values.
- Supported cell styles are number format, font, fill, border, alignment and protection. Conditional formatting's rendered appearance, theme resolution, embedded objects/shapes, comments, row heights, column widths, workbook properties, named ranges, print settings, data validation, VBA code and external-link contents are not compared. Style references are stored XML metadata, not human-rendered Excel appearance.
- Excel does not reliably preserve a distinction between never-populated cells and explicitly saved empty text. The importer preserves what openpyxl supplies. CSV empty strings, whitespace, literal `None`/`NaN`, zero, and leading-zero identifiers remain distinct by default. Numeric equivalence is optional and does not convert leading-zero identifiers or scientific notation strings.
- Record mode requires unique, nonblank header labels and data under labelled columns. Header rows are independently configurable, but source-field mappings/key selections are global to the selected worksheet pairs. For unrelated schemas run separate comparisons. After changing a header row, apply Settings to refresh columns before editing their mappings.
- General Match Records requires the engineer to choose keys. Engineering mode proposes exact `Tag Name` when available. No fuzzy identity matching, automatic header case/spacing mapping, inferred tag renames, semantic row alignment or worksheet-rename inference is attempted. Manual mapping/pairing is supported.
- Duplicate and blank keys are excluded from confirmed changes; diagnostics preserve their rows and raw context. A unique record on one side is also quarantined when its key is duplicated on the other side. Summary counts therefore need not account for every imported row until ambiguities are resolved.
- Engineering rules are advisory checks. Duplicate addresses are checked within literal device/cluster namespaces; absent namespace fields form an unknown shared namespace. Address exceptions are exact raw strings and apply across namespaces. Missing-scaling checks do not infer whether a record is analog or whether scaling is required. Configuring these rules is the engineer's responsibility.
- All matching worksheets means exact shared names. Cells in unpaired worksheets are represented by a structural sheet entry, not expanded into per-cell additions/removals. Common sheets deliberately omitted by the selection appear as notices.
- Excel report row limit is 1,048,576 including the header; use CSV for larger flat results. Imported strings longer than 32,767 characters are preserved in chunks on Long Text. XML-forbidden controls are escaped visibly. CSV formula protection adds an apostrophe which may be visible when opening/re-importing the report. Export protection covers generated reports; manually removing protective prefixes or explicitly converting text to formulas can change spreadsheet behaviour.
- The result model holds all rows in memory and converts values for display as needed; there is no virtual on-disk result store. Comparison and previews use worker threads, but filtering/sorting a very large in-memory result set runs in Qt's GUI model.
- The portable Windows application is unsigned and has no installer, automatic updater or custom icon. Move the complete output folder. Windows 10 x64/Python 3.13.9 were used here; Python 3.12, Windows 11, clean machines without Python, unusual network/OneDrive locking behaviours and extreme path lengths have not been separately verified.
- Tests use synthetic PlantSCADA-style data. Actual ST045 source exports were not supplied. The packaged GUI smoke test automates UI paths on Windows; Explorer-origin dragging by a person and opening exported reports in Microsoft Excel itself were not manually verified.
- PDF export, saved comparison sessions, richer automatic field suggestions, and detailed per-attribute style toggles are deferred. The available formatting checkbox compares all supported style attributes together.
